protocol.source_protocol: source-unit-disjoint pretraining; source validation only; no COMSOL rows or labels
protocol.target_protocol: COMSOL operational aligned-cycle features; tracks 1..N fine-tune, track 4 chronological validation, track 5 final test
protocol.target_scaler: fit on target fine-tuning tracks only
protocol.target_label_scale: fit on target fine-tuning tracks only
protocol.model: source/target domain-specific projections + shared GRU encoder + independently initialized target head
protocol.transfer: pretrained shared encoder copied; target projection and target head initialized independently
protocol.frozen_ablation: shared encoder copied and frozen; target projection/head trainable
protocol.scratch: same target architecture, data, seeds, epochs and early stopping with random initialization
protocol.ridge: target-only baseline; alpha selected on track 4 and refit on tracks 1..N before track 5
protocol.randomness_control: Each source and target model is constructed only after its explicit seed is set; training resets the same seed, deterministic algorithms are requested, and CPU MKLDNN is disabled.
protocol.proxy_warning: COMSOL is a reaction-wheel simulation domain, not real flight telemetry
